source_record.title: Circum-Arctic Resource Appraisal: Estimates of Undiscovered Oil and Gas North of the Arctic Circle
source_record.source_media_type: web citation/transcribed summary; underlying source bytes not locally hashed
source_record.note: Values transcribed from the USGS published fact-sheet summary; this record does not claim independent table reproduction.

scope.geographic_limits_note: The appraisal covers 33 geological provinces north of the Arctic Circle, not the geographic North Pole alone.

reported_qualifiers.meaning: The fact sheet states approximately 84% is expected in offshore areas.

unassessed_dimensions: economic reserves and project-level commercial viability
jurisdiction and delimitation for a specific location
lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions and methane leakage
alternative energy pathways and demand scenarios
limitations: This is an S1 cited transcription, not raw-byte-verified ingestion.
The source publication is from 2008; the result is not a current reserve estimate.
Undiscovered conventional resource estimates are not proved reserves, economic reserves, discoveries or production.
The values describe areas north of the Arctic Circle, not a resource quantity located at the geographic North Pole.
No drilling recommendation, site-specific assessment, legal conclusion or development authorization is provided.
